name: v2-z-limited-speed
covers: Explicit Z axis speed limit during coordinated motion
review: The commanded displacement (20,20,10) mm is 30 mm long; at 80 steps/mm it requires (1600,1600,800) steps each way. The Z component is one third of path speed, so the configured 300 mm/min Z limit caps path speed at 15 mm/s. For a zero-to-zero trapezoid with 100 mm/s^2 acceleration, continuous duration is 30/15 + 15/100 = 2.15 s; recorded durations are 2.14757 and 2.14758 s, about 0.12% shorter. The first move at a 3000 mm/min Z limit previously took 1.09109 s, confirming the limit changes timing. This approximation does not independently verify discrete pulse intervals or physical-board timing.
